dussehra.name: Dussehra - Victory of Good over Evil
dussehra.description: The most important festival of the Rajputs
dussehra.story: For the Rajputs, Dussehra is a celebration of dharma and valour. Its principal rites are the worship of weapons, the buffalo sacrifice, the burning of Ravana's effigy, hymns to the Goddess, and the Ramlila.

holi.name: Holi - Festival of Colors and Unity
holi.significance: Devotion, unity and the destruction of evil
holi.description: A festival of unity and brotherhood in Rajput society
holi.story: After the Holika bonfire come colours and devotion, with Rajasthani songs, dances and traditional dishes.

navratri.name: Navratri
navratri.significance: Worship of the Goddess and the pursuit of Shakti
navratri.description: A nine-day festival of power and devotion
navratri.story: During Navratri the Goddess is worshipped with fasts and devotional dances.

vijayadashami.name: Dussehra / Vijayadashami
vijayadashami.significance: The victory of truth over falsehood
vijayadashami.description: Remembrance of the triumph of dharma
vijayadashami.story: On Vijayadashami weapons are worshipped and evil is symbolically destroyed.

diwali-raj-tilak-diwas.name: Diwali (Raj Tilak Diwas)
diwali-raj-tilak-diwas.significance: Worship of Lakshmi and Ganesha, and remembrance of the royal coronation
diwali-raj-tilak-diwas.description: The festival of lights and the tilak tradition in royal households
diwali-raj-tilak-diwas.story: At Diwali, lamps are lit, Lakshmi and Ganesha are worshipped, and weapons are honoured.

janmashtami.name: Janmashtami
janmashtami.description: A festival of devotion to Krishna
janmashtami.story: Tableaux of Krishna's birth and devotional songs.

shivratri.name: Mahashivratri
shivratri.significance: The union of Shiva and Shakti
shivratri.description: A festival of worship of Shiva
shivratri.story: A night of spiritual practice with Rudrabhishek and fasting.

ram-navami.name: Ram Navami
ram-navami.story: A celebration of Rama's birth and of devotion.

kartik-purnima.name: Kartik Purnima
kartik-purnima.significance: Sacred bathing and offering of lamps
kartik-purnima.description: The tradition of holy bathing and lamp offerings
kartik-purnima.story: Bathing at pilgrimage sites and floating lamps on the water.

basant-panchami.name: Basant Panchami
basant-panchami.story: A celebration of Saraswati and the colours of spring.

akshay-tritiya.name: Akshay Tritiya
akshay-tritiya.description: An auspicious day whose blessings never diminish
akshay-tritiya.story: A day for charity and for beginning auspicious undertakings.

raksha-bandhan.name: Raksha Bandhan
raksha-bandhan.significance: A celebration of the bond between brother and sister
raksha-bandhan.description: A pledge of protection and affection
raksha-bandhan.story: The rakhi and the promise of protection.

teej.name: Teej - Monsoon Festival
teej.description: A festival beloved of Rajput women
teej.story: A celebration of the monsoon month of Sawan, with swings, henna and the sixteen adornments.

gangaur.name: Gangaur Festival
gangaur.significance: Worship of Gauri-Parvati and marital fortune
gangaur.description: The festival of the queen's adornment
gangaur.story: Worship of Mother Gauri, processions on the lakes, and street processions.

gangaur-mela.name: Gangaur Mela
gangaur-mela.significance: The grace of Gauri-Parvati and good fortune
gangaur-mela.description: The great Gangaur fairs and cultural programmes
gangaur-mela.story: Folk dances, songs and cultural performances.

marwar-festival.name: Marwar Festival
marwar-festival.description: The cultural festival of the Jodhpur region
marwar-festival.story: Heroic ballads, dances and the camel show.

desert-festival-jaisalmer.name: Desert Festival (Jaisalmer)
desert-festival-jaisalmer.significance: The cultural heritage of the Thar
desert-festival-jaisalmer.description: A grand celebration of the culture of the Thar Desert

mevar-festival-udaipur.name: Mewar Festival (Udaipur)
mevar-festival-udaipur.description: A celebration of cultural heritage in Udaipur

chittorgarh-jauhar-mela.name: Chittorgarh Jauhar Mela
chittorgarh-jauhar-mela.significance: Remembrance of the jauhar of the Rajput women
chittorgarh-jauhar-mela.description: The spiritual and historical memory of jauhar
chittorgarh-jauhar-mela.story: In memory of the jauhar of Rani Padmini and the women of Chittor.

rajputana-vijay-diwas.name: Rajputana Vijay Diwas
rajputana-vijay-diwas.significance: Remembrance of Rajput victories and valour
rajputana-vijay-diwas.description: A celebration of valour on the anniversaries of victories
rajputana-vijay-diwas.story: A collective remembrance of victories, with the worship of weapons and heroic ballads.

rath-yatra-rajput-warriors.name: Rath Yatra of Rajput Warriors
rath-yatra-rajput-warriors.significance: The warrior tradition and reverence for arms
rath-yatra-rajput-warriors.description: The chariot-procession tradition of Rajput warriors
rath-yatra-rajput-warriors.story: A procession of chariots, with warriors bearing arms and raising victory cries.

shastra-tilak-puja.name: Shastra Tilak / Shastra Puja
shastra-tilak-puja.description: Worship of weapons as instruments of dharma
shastra-tilak-puja.story: Swords, spears, bows and other weapons are marked with tilak while mantras are chanted.

kshatriya-ekadashi.name: Kshatriya Ekadashi
kshatriya-ekadashi.significance: Remembrance of Kshatriya dharma, with a fast
kshatriya-ekadashi.description: Upholding the ideals of Kshatriya dharma
kshatriya-ekadashi.story: A fast, remembrance of dharma, and a renewed vow of valour.

jauhar-smriti-diwas.name: Jauhar Smriti Diwas
jauhar-smriti-diwas.significance: Remembrance of the courage of Rajput women
jauhar-smriti-diwas.description: Remembrance of and homage to the jauhar tradition
jauhar-smriti-diwas.story: The sagas of jauhar are recalled and homage is paid.

haldi-ghati-vijay-parv.name: Haldi Ghati Vijay Parv
haldi-ghati-vijay-parv.description: A celebration of the valour shown at the Battle of Haldighati
haldi-ghati-vijay-parv.story: A remembrance of the valour of Maharana Pratap.

pratap-jayanti.name: Pratap Jayanti
pratap-jayanti.significance: The birth anniversary of Maharana Pratap
pratap-jayanti.description: The grand celebration of Pratap Jayanti in Mewar
pratap-jayanti.story: On Pratap's birth anniversary, weapons are worshipped and songs of valour are sung.

hammir-jayanti.name: Hammir Jayanti
hammir-jayanti.story: A remembrance of Rana Hammir's prowess and his restoration of the kingdom.

durgadas-jayanti.name: Durgadas Jayanti
durgadas-jayanti.description: Remembering the story of Durgadas's courage
durgadas-jayanti.story: The saga of Durgadas Rathore's courage in defending the kingdom.

rawal-nainsi-jayanti.name: Muhnot Nainsi Jayanti
rawal-nainsi-jayanti.significance: Remembrance of Muhnot Nainsi, historian and administrator
rawal-nainsi-jayanti.description: Remembering the contributions of Muhnot Nainsi
rawal-nainsi-jayanti.story: A remembrance of one of the most important chroniclers of Rajasthani history.

mewar-foundation-day.name: Mewar Foundation Day
mewar-foundation-day.significance: Celebration of the founding of the Mewar kingdom
mewar-foundation-day.description: The festival of the historic founding of Mewar
mewar-foundation-day.story: The founding of the kingdom of Mewar and its glorious history.

marwar-foundation-day.name: Marwar Foundation Day
marwar-foundation-day.significance: Celebration of the founding of the Marwar kingdom
marwar-foundation-day.description: The glorious day of Marwar's founding
marwar-foundation-day.story: The founding of the kingdom of Marwar and the history of the Rathore dynasty.

bikaner-foundation-day.name: Bikaner Foundation Day
bikaner-foundation-day.significance: The founding of Bikaner by Rao Bika
bikaner-foundation-day.description: The historic festival of Bikaner's founding
bikaner-foundation-day.story: The founding of Bikaner by Rao Bika, and the celebrations that mark it.
